name: Loco Dice
notable_releases: 7 Dunham Place; Underground Sound Suicide; Flight LB 7475; Seeing Through Shadows
short_bio: Tunisian-German DJ and producer from Düsseldorf, Loco Dice is the co-founder of Desolat alongside Martin Buttrich. Known for sleek minimal techno and tech house, he has released on labels such as Cadenza, M_nus, and his own Desolat, and albums including 7 Dunham Place and Underground Sound Suicide.

name: Guido Schneider
associated_acts: Jens Bond; André Galluzzi; Florian Schirmacher; Glowing Glisses
short_bio: German DJ and producer known for refined minimal/tech house, closely associated with Poker Flat Recordings. Active in the Berlin scene, he has collaborated with Jens Bond and worked as part of Glowing Glisses with vocalist Florian Schirmacher.

name: Hermanez
short_bio: DJ and producer known for tech house and minimal techno.

name: Jeff Samuel
short_bio: American minimal techno and tech house producer/DJ active since the 2000s and associated with the mid-2000s minimal scene.

name: Luciano
associated_labels: Cadenza Records; Perlon; Mental Groove; Soma
associated_acts: Quenum; Ricardo Villalobos; Pier Bucci; Dandy Jack
styles: minimal house; tech house; minimal techno
notable_releases: Orange Mistake (with Quenum); Rise of Angel; Tribute to the Sun (album); Fabric 41: Luciano (mix); Sci.Fi.Hi.Fi. Vol. 2 (mix)
short_bio: Chilean–Swiss DJ and producer, founder of Cadenza Records and a key figure in minimal house and tech house since the early 2000s. Known for Latin-inflected, groove-driven productions and collaborations with peers such as Quenum.

name: Click Box
short_bio: Brazilian minimal techno duo known for releases on Richie Hawtin’s Minus and later Items & Things, bringing a crisp, percussive take on minimal and tech house.

name: Kenichiro Kubota
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: Konrad Black
short_bio: Canadian DJ and producer associated with the Vancouver minimal techno scene and the Wagon Repair label. Known for deep, moody minimal techno and tech house with longstanding ties to Mathew Jonson.

name: Magda
associated_acts: Marc Houle; Troy Pierce; Richie Hawtin; Run Stop Restore
notable_releases: Baby Kate; She's A Dancing Machine (mix); Fabric 49: Magda (mix)
short_bio: Polish-born, Detroit-raised DJ and producer closely associated with Richie Hawtin’s M_nus label, known for stripped-back minimal techno and tech house. She broke through with releases like Baby Kate and the mix CD She’s A Dancing Machine, and later co-founded the Items & Things label with Marc Houle and Troy Pierce.

name: Josh Wink
styles: acid house; acid techno; techno; tech house; house
notable_releases: Higher State of Consciousness; Don't Laugh (as Winx); Are You There?; How's Your Evening So Far? (with Green Velvet); Superfreak (Freak)
short_bio: Philadelphia DJ/producer and co-founder of Ovum Recordings with King Britt. A pioneer of 1990s acid house/techno, he broke through with 'Higher State of Consciousness' and 'Don't Laugh' (as Winx) and has remained an influential club producer and remixer.

name: Ilario Alicante
short_bio: Italian DJ and producer from Livorno, active since the late 2000s. He broke through with the 2008 track "Living Near Africa" on Cécille Records and became closely associated with Cocoon Recordings, known for driving techno and tech house.

name: Innersphere
short_bio: Innersphere is an alias of Amsterdam-based DJ/producer Shinedoe, best known for the mid-2000s minimal/tech house anthem 'Phunk'.

name: Heartthrob
notable_releases: Baby Kate; Dear Painter, Paint Me
short_bio: Heartthrob is the alias of American producer Jesse Siminski, a key figure from Richie Hawtin’s Minus roster who later launched his own imprint ISNISNT. Emerging in the mid‑2000s, he is known for sleek minimal techno and tech-house, including the breakout single Baby Kate and the album Dear Painter, Paint Me.

name: Marco Carola
associated_labels: Design Music; Question; Zenit; M_nus; Music On
associated_acts: Gaetano Parisio; Rino Cerrone; Paco Osuna
notable_releases: Open System (album, 2001); Play It Loud! (album, 2011); Question (EP series)
short_bio: Marco Carola is an Italian DJ and producer from Naples, a key figure in the Neapolitan techno movement. He founded labels such as Design Music, Question and Zenit, later releasing the album Play It Loud! on M_nus and launching the Music On brand in Ibiza. Known for driving, minimalist grooves, he bridges techno and tech house in long-form DJ sets.

name: Massimo Girardi
short_bio: Artist not known: no reliable information available.

name: Gaiser
short_bio: American minimal techno producer Jon Gaiser is a key artist on Richie Hawtin’s Minus label, known for sleek, percussive live sets and streamlined studio work.

name: Kaiserdisco
associated_labels: KD Music; KD RAW; Drumcode; MBF (My Best Friend)
short_bio: Kaiserdisco is a German duo from Hamburg comprising Frederic Berger and Patrick Buck. They are known for groove-led techno and tech house, founding the KD Music and KD RAW labels and releasing on Drumcode as well as MBF. Their early breakthrough included the track Aguja and the album In No One's Shadow.

name: Jorge Savoretti
styles: minimal house; tech house; minimal techno
short_bio: Argentine DJ and producer from Rosario, Jorge Savoretti is a key figure in his country’s minimal/house scene and co-runs the Savor Music label. His groove-led productions and DJ sets span minimal house and tech house, with releases on Savor Music and Germany’s Raum...musik.
